{{Quote|Three more gone, my lord. Two commandos took knives to one another&mdash;hallucination-induced psychosis, apparently&mdash;and Major Strix fled camp.|Maiya Vix|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
'''Strix''' was a [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3638 BBY]] Strix was part of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Hargrev]]'s [[Dread Executioners]], sent to [[Oricon]] on a mission to neutralize the [[Dread Masters]]. However, the terror produced by the Sith Lords on Oricon had overtaken Major Strix and he fled the [[Dread Executioners camp]] in madness.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel" />
